coordinates: start0 is zero-based inclusive, end0 exclusive; manuscript and Excel coordinates are one-based inclusive
distance: global Levenshtein unit cost, sum edits / sum max lengths per array; equal weight across arrays
permutation: 999, count-preserving within each contiguous typed segment; empirical P=(1+count_ge)/1000; unadjusted across arrays/statistics; maximum search matched to observed region
methylation: m/(C+m+h) within individual; six individuals equally weighted; confidence 0.95 is encoding diagnostic only
chr11_substate_audit: The 8077 extracted records preserve the original per-unit states for direct tallying. Source identifiers and file digests are in chr11_and_units/unit_audit.json.
